quests.title: Irodori Poetry: Part II

dialogue.t: Miss(Mister), wonderful timing! Lenne and I were just working on a new poem.

dialogue.sit: Need my help in getting some inspiration again?

dialogue.t: Haha, that's right. Under Ootomo's instruction, I've been composing another poem with an Inazuman style, although admittedly I'm still quite the amateur.

The theme of this poem is "friendship," and indeed both of us can only lament that we did not meet sooner. One of the lines I would like to write depicts animals wandering the landscape in companionship with one another.
Since this is an Inazuman poem, we must reference <color=#00E1FFFF>creatures unique to these lands</color>.
We do see animals unique to Inazuma pretty often — whether it be ones that walk or fly...
But since they all appear out in the wild, let's head out and search for them, {NICKNAME}.
I am in your debt! Please help me take <color=#00E1FFFF>4</color> photos of different animals from Inazuma, then.
Do you have the pictures ready, friend?
No worries. We just need <color=#00E1FFFF>4 pictures of Inazuman animals</color> today. Thanks a lot!
Do you have the pictures ready, friend?
Let me see... Oh, these are great! I think I know what to write now.
I have written a few more versions of a stanza based on the pictures that you brought. Why don't you pick the one we should use once again?
Hehe, if Lenne and I had met when we were younger, we might have gone on romps outdoors just like those crabs and lizards.
I've heard that crossing rivers and seas takes a great deal of time. But if I had a friend with me, I'm sure it would be a glad time.
Friend, since both you and Ootomo love this phrase so, then let us use it.
Lenne's poem and the pictures complement each other a lot. Honestly, the poem just gets more and more moving as you read it and look at the images.
To be honest, I have also been writing a poem for which I might need your aid tomorrow.

dialogue.sit: Do you need me to take some pictures, too?

dialogue.t: Heh, let's talk about it in more detail tomorrow.
I've heard that flying as free as the wind is the dream of all people from Mondstadt. Honestly, I'd say that this phrase suits Lenne very well indeed.
It's just a shame that I didn't enjoy going out as a child. If I had a companion like you then, I might actually have a gliding license now.
Inazuman children often gather together to tell tales of youkai to test each others' courage. These experiences also become precious memories when they have grown up.
I didn't expect that Lenne would be able to connect that to the pictures of these creatures. This stanza has deep meaning indeed.

quests.description: Lenne is busy writing a new poem and appears to need your help once again…
